        'function': 'flb_parser_create',
        'line': 105,
        'var': 'p->time_with_year',
        'code': 'if (strstr(p->time_fmt, \"%Y\")) p->time_with_year = FLB_TRUE',
        'note': 'time_fmt contains %Y so time_with_year is set to FLB_TRUE, meaning flb_strptime will be called directly on the non-null-terminated input'
    },
    {
        'step': 5,
        'file': 'src/flb_parser_logfmt.c',
        'function': 'logfmt_parser',
        'line': 130,
        'var': 'value',

        'note': 'Parser extracts value \"2024\" from input \"time=2024\" where the value extends to the very end of the input buffer'
    },
    {
        'step': 6,
        'file': 'src/flb_parser_logfmt.c',
        'function': 'logfmt_parser',
        'line': 137,
        'var': 'value',
        'code': 'ret = flb_parser_time_lookup((const char *) value, value_len, 0, parser, &tm, tmfrac)',
        'note': 'Non-null-terminated value pointer and length are passed to time lookup'
    },
    {
        'step': 7,
        'file': 'src/flb_parser.c',
        'function': 'flb_parser_time_lookup',
        'line': 390,
        'var': 'time_ptr',
        'code': 'p = flb_strptime(time_ptr, parser->time_fmt, tm)',
        'note': 'flb_strptime is called with a non-null-terminated string pointer into the fuzzer input buffer'
    },
    {
        'step': 8,
        'file': 'src/flb_strptime.c',
        'function': '_flb_strptime',
        'line': 220,
        'var': 'bp',
        'code': 'if (c != *bp++) return (NULL)',
        'note': 'After parsing %Y (\"2024\"), bp points past the end of the input buffer; reading *bp causes heap-buffer-overflow'
    }
]

with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)
print('Trace written to /workspace/candidate_trace.json')
"` executed with exit code 0.
